title: How to backup Thunderbird emails to Outlook (PST)?
creator: sharmahrsh137
content:
To back up Thunderbird emails to Outlook, you need to convert Thunderbird mailbox data into PST format, which is the file type supported by Microsoft Outlook. Manual methods are available, but they usually involve multiple steps and can be difficult when handling large mailboxes.

A simpler approach is to use the SysTools Thunderbird Backup Tool, which allows you to export Thunderbird emails directly to PST while preserving folder hierarchy, attachments, metadata, and email properties. Once the PST file is created, you can easily import it into Outlook and access all your emails without any data loss.
